title: State Commission Jurisdiction for Other Values of Goods and Services

content.scenario: The Central Government prescribes a value of Rs. 50 lakhs for complaints against unfair contracts. A consumer in Chennai files a complaint against a company for an unfair contract worth Rs. 40 lakhs.
content.outcome: The State Commission has jurisdiction to entertain the complaint, as the value of the goods or services paid as consideration is as prescribed by the Central Government, as per Section 101(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

keywords: other value of goods and services
user_queries: What is the jurisdiction of the State Commission for complaints with other values of goods and services?
Can a complaint worth Rs. 40 lakhs be filed with the State Commission if the prescribed value is Rs. 50 lakhs?
What are the conditions for the State Commission to entertain a complaint with a prescribed value?
